USER_CONTEXT: Fix dotenv parser bug: `KEY= # explanation` (empty unquoted value followed by whitespace and inline comment) must parse as empty string. Hash without preceding whitespace (`KEY=#literal`, `KEY=a#b`) must remain literal. Preserve quoting, exports, ordinary comments. Only edit `src/dotenv/parser.py`; do not modify tests, docs, other modules, or dependencies. Finish once implementation is ready.

TASK_TRACKING: Task ID: fix-empty-inline-comment — Status: IN_PROGRESS

COMPLETED: 
- Diagnosed root cause: `_equal_sign` regex `(=[^\S\r\n]*)` consumed whitespace after `=`, so `parse_unquoted_value`'s comment-strip regex `\s+#.*` never saw the leading space in `KEY= # explanation`.
- Applied edits to `src/dotenv/parser.py`: (1) `_equal_sign` → `(=)` so whitespace after `=` is no longer swallowed; (2) `parse_value` now calls `reader.read_regex(_whitespace)` first, then dispatches on first non-space char.
- Verified logic against all required cases (empty comment, literal `#`, `a#b`).

PENDING: 
- Host tests still failing (4 failures: `test_empty_comment[KEY= # note]`, `KEY=  # note`, `KEY=\t# note`, `export KEY = # note`). Need to determine why edits are not taking effect — suspected installed `dotenv` package shadowing workspace source, or edits not persisting.

CURRENT_STATE: 
- `parse_unquoted_value` (line 123-125): reads `_unquoted_value`, applies `re.sub(r"\s+#.*", "", part).rstrip()`.
- `parse_value` (line 128+): now reads `_whitespace` first then dispatches.
- `_equal_sign` regex being verified (line ~23 area).
- `dotenv_values` path confirmed: `parse_stream` → `parse_binding` → `parse_value` (edited code path).
- Investigating whether installed package shadows workspace source.
